text: Real Madrid has won the most La Liga titles, with 36 championships as of the 2023-24 season.
Barcelona has won the second-most La Liga titles, with 27 championships.
Lionel Messi is La Liga's all-time top scorer, having played for Barcelona for most of his career there.
Karim Benzema won the Ballon d'Or in 2022 while playing for Real Madrid in La Liga.
Atletico Madrid is considered one of the 'big three' clubs in La Liga alongside Real Madrid and Barcelona.
Manchester United has won the most Premier League titles, with 13 championships since the league's founding in 1992.
Manchester City has dominated the Premier League in recent years, winning multiple titles under manager Pep Guardiola.
Erling Haaland set the Premier League single-season goal record with 36 goals in the 2022-23 season.
Alan Shearer holds the record for most goals in Premier League history.
The 'Big Six' clubs in the Premier League are Manchester United, Manchester City, Liverpool, Chelsea, Arsenal, and Tottenham Hotspur.
Real Madrid holds the record for most Champions League titles, with 15 wins.
AC Milan has won the Champions League/European Cup 7 times, the second-most of any club.
Cristiano Ronaldo is the all-time top scorer in Champions League history.
The Champions League format includes a group stage followed by knockout rounds, culminating in a single final match at a neutral venue.
Only clubs that finish in the top positions of their domestic league (or win certain domestic cups) qualify for the Champions League.
Lionel Messi holds the record for most goals scored in a single La Liga season, with 50 goals in the 2011-12 season.
Sevilla has won the UEFA Europa League a record number of times among Spanish clubs, though it has never won La Liga.
Cristiano Ronaldo played for Real Madrid in La Liga from 2009 to 2018, winning the league title twice.
Real Madrid and Barcelona's rivalry match is known as El Clasico, one of the most watched club football fixtures in the world.
Real Madrid's Santiago Bernabeu is one of the largest football stadiums in Europe.
Athletic Bilbao has a long-standing policy of primarily fielding players from the Basque region.
Robert Lewandowski joined Barcelona in 2022 and became a leading goal scorer in La Liga.
Arsenal went an entire 2003-04 season unbeaten in the Premier League, a feat known as 'The Invincibles'.
Thierry Henry is considered one of Arsenal's greatest players and a key figure of the Invincibles squad.
The fastest goal in Premier League history was scored by Shane Long in under 8 seconds.
Leicester City won the Premier League title in the 2015-16 season, considered one of the greatest underdog stories in sports.
Mohamed Salah is one of Liverpool's all-time leading goal scorers in the Premier League.
Chelsea won the Premier League title in 2004-05 and 2005-06 under manager Jose Mourinho.
Liverpool won its first Premier League title in the 2019-20 season, ending a 30-year wait for a top-flight league title.
The Premier League consists of 20 clubs, with each team playing every other team twice per season, home and away.
Bayern Munich has won the Champions League 6 times, the most of any German club.
Liverpool has won the Champions League/European Cup 6 times.
Robert Lewandowski scored 5 goals in a single Champions League match for Bayern Munich against Real Madrid in 2020.
Real Madrid won the Champions League for 5 consecutive years from 1956 to 1960, the competition's inaugural years.
Manchester United won the Champions League in 1999 with a dramatic last-minute comeback against Bayern Munich.
Karim Benzema was the top scorer of the 2021-22 Champions League season while playing for Real Madrid.
The Champions League final is played at a different neutral stadium each year, chosen years in advance by UEFA.
Manchester City won their first Champions League title in the 2022-23 season.
The Ballon d'Or is an annual award given to the world's best football player, voted on by journalists and experts.
Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d'Or a record 8 times.
Cristiano Ronaldo has won the Ballon d'Or 5 times.
Rodri won the Ballon d'Or in 2024, playing for Manchester City in the Premier League.
A football match consists of two 45-minute halves, with additional stoppage time added for delays.
Offside is called when an attacking player is nearer to the opponent's goal line than both the ball and the second-last opponent when the ball is played to them.
VAR (Video Assistant Referee) is used in top leagues including the Premier League, La Liga, and the Champions League to review key decisions.
A typical football team formation includes a goalkeeper, defenders, midfielders, and forwards, commonly arranged in formations like 4-4-2 or 4-3-3.
Kylian Mbappe joined Real Madrid from Paris Saint-Germain in 2024 on a free transfer.
Jude Bellingham transferred from Borussia Dortmund to Real Madrid in 2023.
Vinicius Junior is a Brazilian forward who plays for Real Madrid and has become a key attacking player in La Liga and the Champions League.
Lamine Yamal became one of the youngest players to debut for both Barcelona and the Spanish national team.
